verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec at https://motherduck.com/openapi.json returning HTTP 200 with an 'openapi' key, directly satisfying the machine-readable API spec requirement, and this complements documented multi-language SDK/driver APIs. Missing for 10: no first-party docs page explicitly linking/describing the OpenAPI spec's coverage or versioning, and no independent/community corroboration of its completeness.
